specs_json.category: hybrid VTOL delivery drone with tethered droid
specs_json.compute: redundant proprietary flight computers with acoustic DAA processing

notes: Platform 2 'Zip' is a hybrid lift+cruise eVTOL (~55 lb aircraft, 8 lb payload) that hovers ~90 m up and winches down a small maneuverable 'delivery droid' for ~30 cm precision doorstep drops, per FAA filings ~24 mi one-way range. Docks and recharges autonomously on charging arms; uses an acoustic detect-and-avoid system for BVLOS. Commercial rollouts began 2024-2025 with Walmart, Panera, and health systems.

failure_modes.name: Droid tether winch jam
failure_modes.symptoms: Droid fails to descend/retract, aborted delivery, RTB with droid deployed
failure_modes.mitigation: Tether inspection cycles, winch torque monitoring, automated abort-and-return logic

failure_modes.name: Acoustic DAA false positives in noisy environments
failure_modes.symptoms: Unnecessary avoidance maneuvers, route deviations, delayed deliveries
failure_modes.mitigation: Sensor fusion with ADS-B, acoustic model retraining, mic housing maintenance

failure_modes.name: Lift rotor ESC failure during hover-delivery phase
failure_modes.symptoms: Asymmetric thrust in hover, emergency climb-out or parachute event
failure_modes.mitigation: Redundant lift motors sized for one-out hover, ESC health telemetry, pre-dock diagnostics

failure_modes.name: Autonomous dock misalignment
failure_modes.symptoms: Failed capture attempts, repeated go-arounds, charge not initiated
failure_modes.mitigation: Vision-guided approach recalibration, dock fiducial cleaning, wind-limit gating

failure_modes.name: Battery thermal event from rapid recharge cycling
failure_modes.symptoms: Cell overtemp alerts, charge termination, pack swelling
failure_modes.mitigation: Dock-managed charge profiles, cell-level monitoring, scheduled pack retirement

failure_modes.name: Icing/precipitation on wing in cruise
failure_modes.symptoms: Lift degradation, increased power draw, mission aborts
failure_modes.mitigation: Weather gating in fleet dispatch, icing forecast integration, coated surfaces
